turns.text: My account ID is NUHXANYUYD

turns.text: I don't have an order ID

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ok thank you. One moment please

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you know what your membership level is?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: yeah, I'm a gold member

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good news - as a gold member you are able to get an extension.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: incredible! Thanks for your help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem! Did you need anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: nope that's all. Thanks!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good to hear. Hope you have a good day
